adaptation: Selected packed matvec implementation bodies and GGML block tables retained verbatim. LISA entry points bind the original ABI. Split mode disabled; complete output row tiles required.
oracle: models/gguf/oracle.rs: GGML C dequantizers from the pinned revision, finite deterministic xorshift32 blocks, independent f64 dot products at K=2048,5120,6144,10240,17408; 8 output rows, 2 input rows per format. F32 projection tolerance 0.002 + 2e-5*abs(reference).

pointwise_fusions.origin: LISA F32 Qwen graph: ops::conv1d followed by SiLU; threshold-20 softplus/decay and sigmoid; SiLU products.
pointwise_fusions.contract: SafeNoLang (Safe + Precise, default language target); contraction and reassociation disabled. Retain four convolution products and left-to-right additions, stable sigmoid, separate F32 products and softplus threshold. Projection and recurrent kernels are unchanged.
pointwise_fusions.validation: Bitwise comparisons against the original GPU chains: convolution at 1/2/3/7/16 rows and 8/10240 channels; gates and products on every finite bf16 value represented in F32 plus 65536 full-mantissa samples and threshold neighbors; nonzero offsets and invalid layouts. Full-checkpoint serial/prefill, rollback and MTP replay checks repeated.
